page.layout: One printed page, centred. Title lines from top to bottom; below them a woodcut device (oval roundel with a palm tree, a standing figure and a lion, the letters H B, and the motto VIRTUS on the frame, which is part of the image); below the device the imprint in three lines. Marginal and bottom furniture: none. The library stamp at lower right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: In Praefatione Criminatio, quam habet Wolzog.

l.i: Apolog. Part. IV. Cap. IV. retunditur.

page.notes: Woodcut device between the title and the imprint: an oval with a palm tree, a standing nude figure holding a cloth, and a lion lying at right; initials H B below; text on the frame reads VIRTUS (top right) and VERITAS-like lettering is not legible, so the frame's lower text is left untranscribed as decoration. The imprint date is printed as cIↄ Iↄc LXIX, read as MDCLXIX. The "I" of "IOHANNIS" is a decorated initial. The lines "Wolzog." and the final mark after "retunditur." are printed as shown; the original has a small ornament after "Wolzog." which is not a letter.
